A remarkable debut from Danielle Phillips and Mad Friday Productions, Children of the Night is a night out you’ll never want to end.
This is 90ish minutes of nostalgia if you escaped to the dance floors in the late 90s, or an authentic, loud, brash, self-professed love letter to the cultural North.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy love letter to 90s club culture as a thumping, nostalgic anthem to friendship and working-class escape, though some question whether another Yorkshire coming-of-age tale was needed.
